summary: A February 1939 photo caption names towerman Earnest Jones at the Maco fire lookout; a 2022 state groundwater map labels a fire tower at the site.

facts.status_note: A 2022 groundwater map labels a fire tower at the site. No source says whether a structure stands there now.

access.note: The 2022 map says it does not authorize any party to enter the land it depicts.

notes_for_editor: The 1939 photo puts a fire lookout at Maco with a named towerman, but gives no build date, height or end date. The 2022 'fire tower' label is confirmed on the rendered PDF (inset, point 34.289277,-78.156671, beside a USGS monument). The map does not show the tower as close to the monument, so the story does not say so. The map's no-entry note covers all land it depicts, including the tower inset, so access is marked restricted. Photo candidate: Forest History Society Flickr photo (page above), license shown only as 'Some rights reserved'; image URL not retrieved, so no photos entry was written. The map point (34.289277,-78.156671) sits very close to the tnlandforms point.
